critical_notes: START WITH QUOTA CHECK: verify Codex quota available before attempting agents C+D. Run: codex --version || echo 'check quota'. If blocked, document quota status and skip to DI-24-03 decision.

DI-24-02 (agents C+D): Run orchestrate-agents.sh with --resume-missing-only for all 3 plugins. Only agents c and d should need to run. Command: bash tools/bin/orchestrate-agents.sh <slug> --resume-missing-only. If quota still blocked after checking, defer agents C+D and focus on DI-24-03 and S5.

DI-24-03 (benchmark architecture): Read benchmark/compare.py to confirm what field it reads (phase2.verdict or phase3.validation_status). Present two options: (A) keep reading phase2 — simpler, counts gate-UNCERTAIN as FP which is conservative; (B) switch to reading gate validation_status — more accurate, requires C+D to complete first. Recommend option and wait for user approval before implementing.

WAVE4-FINALIZE: After agents C+D complete, run: (1) merge_agent_outputs.py for each plugin, (2) phase3_gate.py for each, (3) phase3_llm_review.py for new uncertain findings, (4) phase3_apply_review.py, (5) benchmark/compare.py --all, (6) update wave_4_results.json. Only do this AFTER quota confirmed.
S5-FIRST-RUN: S5 (skill-set-verify.md) has not been run for any plugin. If wave_4_results.json is finalized and Codex quota available, run S5 on backwpup (has 2 GT findings). Document results.
E1 applies: source_ref wins. E5 applies: no scope expansion beyond gap IDs. E4 applies: PHP/Python null discipline in any new code.
